subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Exceptionally clever or talented
solution:
The correct answer is **"Ingenious."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Ingenious"** means (used about a person) full of new ideas and clever at finding solutions to problems or at inventing things. ((व्‍यक्ति) नए विचारों से युक्त और समस्‍याओं के समाधान या नई बातों के आविष्‍कार में दक्ष; प्रतिभाशाली, मेधावी, विदग्‍ध)

 
 
• **Example**: *Leonardo da Vinci was an **ingenious**__ artist, inventor, and scientist.*
 
 
 
• It is derived from the Latin word **'ingenium'** which means natural capacity or talent.
 
• Exceptionally clever or talented means **"Ingenious."**
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Option 1, Indigenous**, means originating or occurring naturally in a particular place; native. ((मनुष्‍य, पशु या पौधे) अपने मूल स्‍थान में स्थित; स्‍वदेशी, स्‍थानीय)

 
 
• **Example**: *The **indigenous**__ people of Australia are known as the Aboriginals.*
 
 
 
• **Option 2, Studious**, means spending a lot of time studying or reading. ((व्यक्ति) अध्‍ययन में काफ़ी अधिक समय लगाने वाला; अध्‍ययनशील)
 __
 
• **Example**: *She is a **studious**__ student who always gets good grades.*
 
 
 
• **Option 3, Assiduous**, means showing great care and perseverance. (परिश्रमी, अध्यवसायी, मेहनती)
 __
 
• **Example**: *The **assiduous**__ worker never leaves any task unfinished.*
